$comment: EAS build configuration file for HomestayMobileApp. Top-level keys configure build profiles and CLI version requirements.

development.$comment: Development build profile: builds an Expo Dev Client runtime binary rather than a standalone production APK.

preview.$comment: Preview build profile: builds a standalone, installable Android APK file (.apk) directly for sideloading and operator testing without requiring Google Play Store submission.

production.$comment: Production build profile: standard Android App Bundle (.aab) generation ready for Google Play Store upload.

submit.$comment: Submit profiles define configurations for automatically uploading binaries to app stores.
